{{Top|leg}}
A '''blossug''' was a proboscis inside the mouths of the [[Viska (species)|Viska]]. It was forty [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] long, and consisted of several layers of muscle and a hollow bone with a jagged tip. It was used by the Viska to feed by drawing [[Blood/Legends|blood]].
